description.value:
You open your eyes, and whatever you have been holding goes out all at once.

Remove @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Effect: Om]. All stacks are spent and reset to 0, and the next Technique you cast or unarmed Strike you make before the end of that turn is empowered:

  • +2 damage dice per stack spent, and
  • if it allows a saving throw, a −1 circumstance penalty per 2 stacks spent to that save.

You are no longer blinded.

Your eyes open automatically, spending nothing, if you are knocked unconscious.

The empowerment is applied by hand: it lands on one roll and depends on how many stacks you had, which no rule element can read after the effect is gone.
